criteria.text: The /integrations collection and provider, assistant-tools, and import deep links render the page-integrations contract inside the selected Rhythm shell with exactly one Integrations h1, while unknown section links recover without leaving the page.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c1: integrations routes render the real page and section deep links

criteria.text: Service cards represent connected, disconnected, syncing, stored error, and needs-reauth permission states truthfully, show available account identity and prerequisite copy, and expose only Flutter-supported Connect, Reconnect, Sync, settings, and read-only signal actions.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c2: provider cards distinguish connection sync error and permission states

criteria.text: The ready, loading, empty, server-error, forbidden, unavailable, and readonly state matrix is deterministic; Retry recovers without reload, empty exposes Connect Google, prerequisites are named, and readonly preserves inspection while natively disabling every mutation.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c3: deterministic state matrix remains actionable and readonly is native

criteria.text: Every enabled Integrations control has a stable kebab-case data-testid and an observable outcome; client-only controls add no fake receipt, and dialogs or handoffs close on Escape and restore focus.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c4: enabled controls are live identifiable and restore focus

criteria.text: The visible page-trace ledger appends the exact conditional account, settings, signals, preferences, options, save, sync, OAuth-fixture, and AI-import endpoint receipts in Flutter order with meaningful payload keys and truthful simulated statuses, while excluding client-only actions.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c5: visible ledger is exact append only and excludes client controls

criteria.text: The ready Integrations page, Planning Center preferences dialog, AI Import dialog, and OAuth fixture handoff have zero serious or critical axe violations, labelled controls and live regions, ordered headings, and contained modal keyboard focus.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c6: page dialogs and fixture handoff are accessible

criteria.text: Integrations has no page-level horizontal overflow at 1440, 1024, 768, or 390 CSS pixels and remains usable with 200 percent text, RTL, reduced motion, forced colors, long CJK and emoji content, responsive dialogs, and 44 pixel touch targets.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c7: integrations remains responsive under required presentation modes

criteria.text: Integrations is deterministic and fixture-only: no production, local API, analytics, AI, or OAuth host is contacted; fixture OAuth is an in-page handoff; and reload restores identical accounts, signals, selections, preferences, and timestamps after local mutations.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c8: fixtures block every external and OAuth request and reset on reload

criteria.text: Google and Planning Center Connect or Reconnect actions show an explicit service-specific OAuth FIXTURE HANDOFF, record only the simulated begin-route receipt, keep the Integrations hash route, and never open or contact a real external URL.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c9: connect actions expose explicit OAuth fixture handoffs without navigation

criteria.text: Google Calendar sources support per-calendar, All, and None selection with primary labels and an accurate selected count; Save submits sorted available IDs, refreshes settings, syncs Calendar, refreshes accounts, updates visible saved state and receipts, and exposes truthful recoverable failure without discarding selection.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c10: calendar sources select validate save sync and recover truthfully

criteria.text: Gmail renders the unread total and at most five source-ordered signals deduplicated by thread with sender, fallback subject, and optional snippet; Sync shows progress, refreshes signals and account metadata, and a deterministic failed sync retains prior signals with a provider Retry that succeeds.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c11: Gmail signals dedupe display sync failure and retry

criteria.text: Planning Center Choose lazily loads team and position options, the dialog treats empty sections as no restriction, filters and prunes positions according to selected teams, Cancel preserves saved values, and Save submits sorted teamIds and positionNames then updates visible summaries and receipts.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c12: Planning Center dependent team and position preferences save exactly

criteria.text: The assistant Google-tools consent remains visibly separate from Calendar and Gmail metadata connections, explains its broader read-and-send authority, and produces only an intent-agent OAuth FIXTURE HANDOFF and exact simulated begin receipt.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c13: assistant Google consent remains separate and fixture safe

criteria.text: Individual provider sync and Sync all expose announced progress and disable duplicate activation; success updates provider summaries, and HTTP-200 sync-all partial errors identify successful and failed providers, preserve truthful receipts, and Retry failed retries only the failed providers without duplicating successes.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c14: individual and sync all operations expose progress partial failure and retry

criteria.text: AI Import exposes the Flutter prompt and structured or legacy JSON formats without contacting an AI service, validates empty, invalid, fenced, and non-array section input, creates supported tasks then rhythms then project templates and steps with exact receipts, reports deterministic counts or partial failures, and retries remaining records without duplicating successful imports.
criteria.test_id: issue-2009-c15: AI Import validates formats reports exact outcomes and retries safely
